controls.title: Storage encryption at rest

provider_mappings.azure: Azure Policy: Storage accounts should use infrastructure encryption

controls.remediation: Enable provider-managed or customer-managed encryption for the storage resource.

controls.title: Production service availability SLO
controls.remediation: Review error-budget burn, dependencies, and redundancy before accepting new reliability risk.

controls.title: Audit logging enabled
controls.remediation: Enable centralized audit logging and route logs to the approved retention destination.

controls.title: Required cost-center tag

provider_mappings.azure: Azure Policy: require a tag on resources
provider_mappings.gcp: Organization Policy custom constraint for resource tags

controls.remediation: Add the approved cost-center tag and owner value to the resource.
